About the Scholarship

ISSF (International Master in Sustainable Food Systems) is an Erasmus Mundus joint master that trains specialists in food-system transitions, combining agronomy, ecology, economics and policy across a consortium of leading European universities. The consortium has announced a 2027 intake with application details to be published on its how-to-apply page.

HostISSF Consortium
LocationGhent (multi-country mobility), Belgium
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline2027 intake details coming soon on the official how-to-apply page
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

ISSF (International Master in Sustainable Food Systems) is an Erasmus Mundus joint master that trains specialists in food-system transitions, combining agronomy, ecology, economics and policy across a consortium of leading European universities. The consortium has announced a 2027 intake with application details to be published on its how-to-apply page.

Programme Highlights

  • Systems approach to food production, environment, nutrition and livelihoods
  • Mobility across European partner universities with field work in the Global South in past editions
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarship round in previous intakes ran on a January timeline
  • Graduates work in FAO-type agencies, research institutes, food companies and NGOs

Who Should Apply

Agricultural, biological, environmental and food-science graduates are the core audience, and the consortium also welcomes economics and development-studies applicants with a clear food-systems interest.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students in past rounds: tuition coverage plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the official ISSF how-to-apply page for the 2027 intake announcement; document requirements historically follow the standard Erasmus Mundus checklist. Key deadline information: 2027 intake details coming soon on the official how-to-apply page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About ISSF Consortium

The ISSF consortium groups European universities specialised in agronomy, food science and rural development to deliver the Erasmus Mundus International Master in Sustainable Food Systems. Its alumni work on food-system transformation in research, policy and industry.

Official website: https://issf-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 2027 intake details coming soon - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
